name: voice-dictation
description: Press a key, speak, text appears. 100% local, private speech-to-text dictation for VS Code and Antigravity, powered by faster-whisper.
author: malts1933

voiceDictation.serverUrl.description: URL of the local whisper server

voiceDictation.language.description: Recognition language: auto, Russian or English

voiceDictation.addTrailingSpace.description: Append a space after inserted text

voiceDictation.sentencesOnNewLine.description: Split dictation into sentences — each sentence on its own line (pause/punctuation based)

voiceDictation.autoStartServer.description: Automatically start the local server when dictating and it is not running

voiceDictation.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter with faster-whisper installed (pythonw.exe = no console window). Leave empty for auto-detection.

voiceDictation.model.description: Whisper model size (small = good balance, medium = more accurate but slower)

voiceDictation.serverIdleSeconds.description: Server shuts down by itself after this many seconds without use (0 = keep running)
